Questions

Is FutureX free?

Yes. The calculator, live chart, 7-day forecast, indicators and alerts for one coin are free with no signup. Pro and Trader add more timeframes, the ML ensemble, the Analysis Hub, more alert coins, Telegram and live liquidations. See pricing.

Does FutureX place trades or hold my money?

No. FutureX never connects to your exchange account and never holds funds or API keys. It's an analysis tool; you place trades on your exchange yourself.

Can the AI predict the price?

No one can reliably predict short-term crypto prices. Our forecasts are statistical and machine-learning estimates with uncertainty bands. Their track record, good and bad, is on the accuracy page. Treat them as one input, never as a signal to bet on.

Which exchanges' numbers does the calculator match?

It uses the standard isolated-margin formulas used by major perpetual exchanges, with a 0.5% maintenance margin and 0.05% taker fee by default. Exchanges use tiered margin rates for large positions, so always confirm the liquidation price on your exchange before trading.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. Manage or cancel your plan from the app (Manage billing). You keep access until the end of the period you paid for. See the refund policy.
